title: Claudot Code update for Fable!!! Claudot code also de-updated for Fable!
author: unwittingyeti
selftext:
Hello Prompters!

I hope you have been enjoying this wild ride as much as I have. I spent my taste of Fable having Fable update my Claude//Godot engine bridge for Fable, just in time for Fable to fade into a fable.

Was it a fun few days of gamedev or was it all just a tall tale? Only time will tell.

In the meantime, Claudot has been updated to work with any provider that uses an OpenAI compliant whatchamacallit (via Ollama too). I ~~thoroughly~~ tested this by sending exactly 3 calls to OpenAI via API and it confirmed access to MCP tools. Ship it? Ship it. 

I don't have the local resources to test the Ollama stuff so if some total hunk of a redditor wants to let me know if it works that would be amaze.

Looking forward to Fable (on Xbox gamepass™ February 2027),  
Unwittingyeti

[https://claudotcode.com/](https://claudotcode.com/)
